name: Fall Out Boy

whyMatters.en: Chicago emo/pop-punk four that turned dense lyric couplets and Stump melody into mid-2000s Warped-to-arena: Sugar, We're Goin Down (2005) then Centuries (2014) stadium reboot.
whyMatters.zh: 芝加哥 emo/pop-punk 四人组：把密歌词对句与 Stump 旋律做成 2000 年代中 Warped 到 arena——Sugar, We're Goin Down（2005），再到 Centuries（2014）体育场重启。

lyricQuotes: We're going down, down in an earlier round / And Sugar, we're going down swinging
Some legends are told / Some turn to dust or to gold

shortBio.en: Chicago emo-punk four; From Under the Cork Tree breakthrough, Centuries as 2010s stadium return.
shortBio.zh: 芝加哥 emo-punk 四人；From Under the Cork Tree 突破，Centuries 作 2010 年代体育场回归。

body.en:
Formed 2001 in Chicago hardcore/emo circles. Take This to Your Grave (2003) then From Under the Cork Tree (2005, Neal Avron): Sugar, We're Goin Down and Dance, Dance—Wentz dense couplets, Stump soul-edged melodic chorus, Trohman/Hurley punch.

Infinity on High (2007) adds Thnks fr th Mmrs. Hiatus ~2009–2013; Save Rock and Roll / American Beauty/American Psycho yield Centuries—chant stadium production over the same four names. Craft is lyric density + pop chorus, not DIY ethics alone.
body.zh:
2001 年于芝加哥 hardcore/emo 圈组建。Take This to Your Grave（2003）再到 From Under the Cork Tree（2005，Neal Avron）：Sugar, We're Goin Down 与 Dance, Dance——Wentz 密对句、Stump 带 soul 边的旋律副歌、Trohman/Hurley 冲击。

Infinity on High（2007）加入 Thnks fr th Mmrs。约 2009–2013 停摆；Save Rock and Roll / American Beauty/American Psycho 产出 Centuries——口号体育场制作压同一四人名。工艺是歌词密度 + 流行副歌，非仅 DIY 伦理。

note.en: Cork Tree breakthrough; Wentz couplet + Stump chorus hook.
note.zh: Cork Tree 突破；Wentz 对句 + Stump 副歌钩子。

note.en: Syncopated verse punch; mid-2000s emo-punk radio twin.
note.zh: 切分主歌冲击；2000 年代中 emo-punk 电台成对曲。

note.en: Chant stadium reboot; post-hiatus American Beauty era.
note.zh: 口号体育场重启；停摆后 American Beauty 期。

body.en:
Wentz writes stacked references and couplets; Stump sings them as R&B-aware pop melodies over Trohman power chords.

Sugar, We're Goin Down is the 2005 citation. Centuries later swaps Warped grit for chant arena production.

Same four names, different mix loudness and hook scale.
body.zh:
Wentz 写叠引用与对句；Stump 用带 R&B 意识的流行旋律唱出，压 Trohman power chords。

Sugar, We're Goin Down 是 2005 引用曲。Centuries 后来把 Warped 砂感换成口号 arena 制作。

同一四人名，不同混音响度与钩子体量。

body.en:
Early drummers rotate; Hurley locks 2003. Stump/Wentz/Trohman/Hurley hold through hiatus and return.

No classic fracture—brand is the four.

Peak commercial units: Cork Tree 2005 and Centuries 2014.
body.zh:
早期鼓手轮换；Hurley 2003 钉住。Stump/Wentz/Trohman/Hurley 撑过停摆与回归。

无经典分裂——品牌即四人。

商业巅峰单位：Cork Tree 2005 与 Centuries 2014。

title.zh: Emo-punk 到 arena 复兴桥

body.en:
Mid-2000s scene peers (MCR, Panic!) share the Warped-to-MTV path; Fall Out Boy lean hardest into pop chorus engineering.

Centuries cited as 2010s emo revival stadium template.

Debt to Green Day melody + hardcore scene energy.
body.zh:
2000 年代中同代（MCR、Panic!）共享 Warped 到 MTV 路径；Fall Out Boy 最用力做流行副歌工程。

Centuries 被引为 2010 年代 emo 复兴体育场模板。

债务：Green Day 旋律 + hardcore 场景能量。
